reports.title: Ronald Perry: Prevention of future deaths report
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: During the course of the inquest it was difficult to be clear at times as to what care had been delivered or what steps had been taken because the documentation relating to care and risk was poor.
concerns.hazard: incomplete documentation of care and risk

concerns.quote: The falls risk assessment documentation was incomplete and did not appear to have been updated after falls had occurred.

The falls policy regarding the need to seek medical advice where a resident on anticoagulation had a fall that had been unwitnessed did not seem to be widely understood by staff or adhered to on all occasions.
concerns.hazard: lack of understanding and adherence to falls policy for anticoagulated residents

links.explanation: Both reports highlight inadequate documentation systems that hinder proper monitoring of resident care and risk. The later report adds specifics about falls assessments and policy adherence while sharing the core issue of poor documentation.
